description: G3 token-overlap leakage whitelist for PHASE6_REDO recommendations-v2.json (docs/PHASE6_REDO.md §9 G3). Used by aggregate-track-a.mjs to decide which generic 3-grams in a candidate `instruction_text` are safe (language names, framework names, the literal cell labels V1-V7). DO NOT add repo-specific identifiers or symbol-shaped tokens — if a generic phrase trips the gate, audit the gold corpus instead of widening this list.
addingDiscipline: Subsequent additions only via documented PR with rationale in the PR description. If you find a real symbol or path leak entering this list, STOP — the right fix is to re-author the offending instruction_text, not whitelist the leak.
